info.title: Inkay-Protarium
info.author: Katsu, Noctis
info.details:
Custom fork of Inkay designed to connect the Wii U to Protarium Network servers.

It handles network redirection for online play and custom services (like Protaverse and titles unsupported elsewhere), while keeping Pretendo support active.

Settings can be toggled in the Aroma plugin menu (L + D-Pad Down + Minus).

Requires Aroma.

changelog:
### Changes

- Switched default network endpoints to Protarium Network.
- Added support for Protaverse redirection.
- Retained Pretendo fallback/hybrid support for compatible titles.
- Updated plugin configuration strings in the Aroma config menu.
- General stability improvements and minor fixes.
